reports.title: Blackpool & Fylde: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: With finite resources, it is acknowledged that it may not be possible for all young people to be assessed in as timely a manner as required, but there must surely come a point whereby, notwithstanding those finite resources, the wait for assessment is taking too long.
The wait for assessment placed [REDACTED] at risk, and other children will be similarly at risk in the absence of a timely assessment.

It is possible that had he been diagnosed earlier, and with enough time for the relevant professionals to have been able to carry out some meaningful work with him, and had his extremely supportive Parents been given more support, [REDACTED] death may have been avoided.
